name: Ideal Option
one_liner: Outpatient addiction clinics that prescribe buprenorphine (Suboxone, Sublocade) with counseling, in nine US states.
best_for: Adults with opioid use disorder, including fentanyl, who want to start buprenorphine quickly
People with Medicaid or Medicare looking for medication treatment for addiction
People in one of its nine states who want in-person clinic care with video follow-ups
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988; for an overdose call 911
People who want methadone or residential treatment
People outside its nine states or who can only do fully virtual care
People looking for general therapy or psychiatry not related to substance use
short_description: Office-based addiction medicine clinics offering buprenorphine treatment and counseling in nine states; accepts Medicaid, Medicare and commercial insurance.
long_description: Ideal Option is a chain of more than 80 outpatient addiction medicine clinics in Alaska, Arkansas, Idaho, Maryland, Montana, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oregon and Washington. Clinicians treat substance use disorder, mainly opioid use disorder, with FDA-approved medications such as buprenorphine (Suboxone, Zubsolv, Sublocade, Brixadi), along with counseling and drug testing. The company says it aims to see new patients within 24 hours or the same day; first visits are generally in person, and established patients can use video visits. It accepts Medicaid, Medicare and most commercial insurance and says it offers affordable payment for people without insurance, but it does not publish a self-pay price. It publishes its own annual patient-outcomes reports; no peer-reviewed study of its program was found.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance (Medicaid, Medicare, commercial); self-pay price not published
pricing.notes: Accepts Medicaid, Medicare and most commercial plans. Says it offers affordable options for uninsured patients but gives no self-pay figure; call 1-877-522-1275 for a quote.

privacy.notes: Website policy says it will not sell or rent your information and you can ask for it to be deleted; a HIPAA notice for clinic records was not found in this check.

faqs.a: Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

primary_uses: Starting buprenorphine for opioid use disorder
Treatment for alcohol and stimulant use

patient_summary: You visit an Ideal Option clinic, usually in person for the first appointment, where an addiction medicine clinician can start buprenorphine or other medication for opioid, alcohol or stimulant use, with counseling and follow-up visits by clinic or video. It takes Medicaid, Medicare and most commercial insurance, and says it offers affordable self-pay options if you are uninsured.

availability.note: 80+ in-person clinics in AK, AR, ID, MD, MT, NM, ND, OR and WA. First visits generally in person; video visits for established patients.
